intro: The Lenny face ( ͡° ͜ʖ ͡°) is a suggestive, knowing text face built from Unicode combining marks — the ͡ tilde arches the brows and the ͜ mark forms the smirk. Because a Lenny face is plain Unicode text, it pastes cleanly into Discord, chat, comments, bios, and usernames with no image needed. Browse the classic Lenny, plus happy, winking, smug, flexing, and action variants below, and click any face to copy it instantly.
